name: Tailored Linen Blazer
description: Crafted from breathable Italian linen, this tailored blazer features structured shoulders, a single-button closure, and double-welt pockets. Perfect for smart-casual summer layering.

name: Minimalist Wool Trousers
description: Constructed from lightweight virgin wool blend, these trousers offer a clean straight-leg silhouette, pressed creases, and a hidden zip fly for a sleek minimalist look.

name: Silk Mock-Neck Knit
description: Indulgently soft silk-cotton blend knitwear featuring a modern mock neckline and finely ribbed cuffs. A versatile layer that drapes beautifully.

name: Asymmetric Satin Slip Dress
description: A fluid satin dress cut on the bias to drape gracefully. Features adjustable criss-cross back straps and a delicate asymmetric cowl neckline.

name: Structured Cotton Co-Ord Set
description: A contemporary matching set featuring a structured short-sleeve button-down top and matching high-waisted wide-leg trousers. Made from organic structured cotton.

name: Bohemian Floral Midi Dress
description: An airy georgette midi dress detailed with a custom vintage floral print, subtle tiered hem, and elasticated blouson sleeves.

name: Classic White Poplin Shirt
description: A crisp, cotton poplin shirt featuring a relaxed boyfriend fit, pointed collar, and mother-of-pearl buttons. An indispensable wardrobe foundation piece.

name: High-Waist Pleated Shorts
description: Elevated tailor-pleated shorts designed with a high rise, wide leg openings, and a matching fabric belt to cinch the waist.

name: Linen Utility Co-Ord
description: A casual linen set including an oversized utility shirt with chest pockets and easy pull-on drawstring shorts. Garment-dyed for a soft, worn-in feel.
